scripts.build:go: cd ../BE/arfni && go build -o ./bin/ic.exe ./cmd/ic && go build -o ./bin/arfni-go.exe ./cmd/arfni-go && go build -o ./bin/arfni-monitoring.exe ./cmd/arfni-monitoring
scripts.copy:binaries: powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path src-tauri/resources/bin | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Path ../BE/arfni/bin/*.exe -Destination src-tauri/resources/bin/"
scripts.copy:plugins: powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path src-tauri/resources/plugins | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Path public/plugins/bundled -Destination src-tauri/resources/plugins/ -Recurse -Force"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:go && npm run copy:binaries && npm run copy:plugins && npm run build
